The `cleanup-azure-instances` CI job now reads the Azure test-subscription service principal (`AZURE_CLIENT_ID`, `AZURE_TENANT_ID`, `AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET`, `AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID`) from Vault at `mngr/ci/AZURE_*` through the same `use-vault-secrets` step the Vultr, AWS, and GCP cleanup jobs use, instead of GitHub Actions secrets. The job now fails loudly if the entries are absent rather than silently no-opping.
